ns2:course.label: Rome: The Eternal City
ns2:course.description: Considers the architecture and urbanism of the city of Rome across time. Special focus will be placed on critical strategies for understanding urban sites. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Sophomore standing.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Sophomore standing.
